title: Glow and wipes
summary: Make a title glow with an adjustment layer, then wipe it on with a keyed Linear Wipe.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.text:
An adjustment layer changes everything below it, and it can hold many effects: glows, wipes, color, blurs. Each one's settings can be keyed, so they change over time.

The Title layer holds a white title with a blue line under it.

steps.title: Add a layer
steps.text: Click the Title layer's name, then click the New Layer button under the layers, or choose Insert > Timeline > Layer. The new layer goes above it.

steps.title: Make it an adjustment layer
steps.text: Right-click the new layer's name and choose Adjustment Layer. Everything below it blurs: a new adjustment layer starts with a Blur.

steps.title: Take the blur away
steps.text: Click an empty part of the stage so nothing is selected. The Behaviors panel shows the layer's effects. With Blur picked in its list, click Remove.

steps.title: Add a glow
steps.text: Click Add Effect and choose Glow. The bright parts of the picture, the white letters and the blue line, spread their light around them.

steps.title: Make it brighter
steps.text:
Set Radius (pixels) to 24 and Intensity (percent) to 150 for a bigger, stronger glow.

Threshold says how bright a part must be to glow; Glow color tints the light, such as #38D8FF for neon.

steps.title: Add a wipe
steps.text: Click Add Effect again and choose Linear Wipe. It wipes the picture away behind a moving edge.

steps.title: Wipe from the left
steps.text: Set Direction (degrees) to 180. The wipe now runs the other way, so the title will be uncovered from its left, the way it reads.

steps.title: Key it wiped away
steps.text: The playhead is on frame 1. Set Completion (percent) to 100: the title is wiped away. Then click the diamond beside it to key it on this frame.

steps.title: Go to frame 24
steps.text: Click 24 in the frame numbers above the layers.

steps.title: Uncover it
steps.text: Set Completion (percent) to 0. Since the setting is keyed, this makes a second key here.

steps.title: Play it
steps.text: Press Enter, or click the play button in the timeline header. The glowing title is wiped on from the left, with a soft edge.

steps.title: Well done
steps.text:
You made a title glow and wiped it on with keyed effects on an adjustment layer. Effects apply in the order of the list: the wipe here wipes the glow too.

Try Radial Wipe or Venetian Blinds in place of the Linear Wipe, and Feather for a softer or harder edge.
